## F — Research index and VERIFY list: graduated licensing and first-time adult applicants
Knowledge index: C.01 contains 30 original fact blocks; C2.01 contains 22 continuation fact blocks, all from this section’s mapped physical pages.
Authority and exam facts are located in A.01; audience in B.01; accuracy limits in D.01; demand and competitor gaps in E.01 and E2.01.
VERIFY list:
- DE-GDL-COUNT: The handbook does not state the knowledge-test question count; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a count.
- DE-GDL-PASS: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test passing percentage or passing score; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a threshold.
- DE-GDL-TIME: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test time limit; do not substitute the road-exam duration.
- DE-GDL-CADENCE: The snapshot is dated July on the front cover; the frequency of handbook revision was not independently verified.
- DE-GDL-COVER: The extracted cover text carries the edition but not the graphical title or issuer; the issuer is established separately by frontmatter and the official linking page.
- DE-GDL-MARKET: market pack requires sourced recon.
- DE-GDL-TEARDOWN: competitive teardown requires sourced inspection.
Dynamic isolation: Sponsor and learner rules are pinned to this handbook edition; contact details and submission addresses require current confirmation.

corpus_stability.reason: Working assessment from a single dated July edition and no indication of multiple yearly revisions in the selected pages; revision cadence has not been independently confirmed.
